name: FAdxSmaStrategy (ADX-gated SMA cross, long+short futures)
author: freqtrade-strategies
entry_long: Long: ADX>pos_entry_adx AND SMA_short crosses above SMA_long
entry_short: ADX>pos_entry_adx AND SMA_short crosses below SMA_long
exit: close conditions on opposite cross/ADX (see source)
implementation_notes: Defaults of periods in class attributes; futures leverage param. Freqtrade note: minimal_roi/stoploss are part of the published strategy; ROI exits are time-since-entry based. Source file is the sole spec; no independent verification of results.
